text.hi: किताब का खेल: सबके नाम की पर्चियाँ मिला दी गई हैं। अपनी पर्ची ढूँढने के लिए पूछो: Do you have my name slip with you? जवाब: Yes, I have. / No, I don't have.
text.hinglish: Kitaab ka khel: sabke naam ki parchiyaan mila di gayi hain. Apni parchi dhoondhne ke liye poochho: Do you have my name slip with you? Jawab: Yes, I have. / No, I don't have.
text.en: The book's game: everyone's name slips are mixed up. To find yours, ask: Do you have my name slip with you? Answer: Yes, I have. / No, I don't have.
